fields.description: Eight states, four of them endings. needs_review exists so 'I cannot tell' is sayable; never collapse it into failed.
fields.label: State
fields.options:
idle
awaiting
detected
confirming
confirmed
expired
failed
needs_review

fields.description: What the operator sees. confirmed shows as SETTLED.
fields.label: Shown As

fields.description: Which Done-screen variant applies. unidentified = money sighted but not nameable. unverified = the final look never reached the chain.
fields.label: Ending

fields.description: Written once by charge(). Nothing mid-flight may reclassify a sale.
fields.label: Snapshotted At Charge

fields.description: The SALE's mode, not the terminal's switch. A mid-flight mode flip reclassifies nothing.
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: Stamped from the transport that actually answered. A simulated answer can only downgrade this, never upgrade it.
fields.label: Provenance

fields.description: Self-declared trading name as configured at charge. Stored so a reprint says what the customer was handed.
fields.label: Merchant Name

fields.description: THE amount, exact integer as a string. Stored as text because wei overflows bigint. URI, display and tolerance all derive from this one integer.
fields.label: Invoiced (native units)

fields.description: BOUND money: arrived AND nameable. This is the only figure that books.
fields.label: Credited (bound)

fields.description: UNBOUND money: real, but not provably this sale's. Displays and never books. A sale holding only this parks as NEEDS REVIEW.
fields.label: Sighted (unbound)

fields.description: A rate is not a number. It is a number, a source, and a time.
fields.label: The Rate

fields.description: Cents x 10^4. Integer cents build a 3.3% error into the unit for a cheap asset, which is exactly where a terminal must be more precise.
fields.label: Rate (microcents per whole coin)

fields.description: Who said so. A number nobody can attribute is not presented as verified.
fields.label: Rate Source

fields.description: When the quote was read from the feed, not the charge time. The gap is staleness the operator is entitled to see.
fields.label: Rate Read At

fields.description: Whose address that was. A sale can be REAL and SETTLED while watching a placeholder nobody holds the keys to.
fields.label: Identity Source

fields.description: Rail extras: reference, payment_id, subaddr_index, memo, baseline.
fields.label: Identity Extras

fields.description: The encoded module grid. Stored as data rather than markup because HTML sanitisation strips the attributes an inline SVG needs.
fields.label: QR Modules

fields.description: When the money actually arrived, which is not when it was charged. Empty on a sale that never settled.
fields.label: Settled At

fields.description: Readable, sequential.
fields.label: Invoice Id

fields.description: Unguessable, unordered.
fields.label: Invoice Ref

fields.description: Emitted only on a settled, bound, real sale. An uncertain sale has no invoice by design.
fields.label: ERPNext Sales Invoice

fields.description: Points per cent, snapshotted at charge. 0 means earning was not offered.
fields.label: Loyalty Earn Rate

fields.description: An address, never a key.
fields.label: Loyalty Account

fields.description: What the network said, after the sale was booked. Nothing here may block a sale.
fields.label: Loyalty Award

fields.description: Append-only. A record edited to stay current stops being a record.
fields.label: State Transitions
